title: Gacha Decoding: Eliciting Diverse Generations Through Instruction Following
abstract: arXiv:2610.01382v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce Gacha Decoding, an inference-time method for eliciting diverse language model generations that scales with model capability. Across open-ended domains (in-the-wild chat, creative writing, planning for image generation, and protein design), Gacha Decoding significantly outperforms existing generation diversity approaches at equal quality (up to 2.4x Vendi over the next-best prior approach), reaching the same number of high-quality modes with over an order of magnitude fewer samples (11.0x) and discovering novel modes that no other approach surfaces. Our key insight is to treat diversity as an instruction-following problem: rather than relying on the LM's token entropy, we combine its instruction-following capability with randomness from an external RNG tool to scalably identify and realize distinct modes of the response space. translated_title: 扭蛋解码：通过指令遵循引出多样化的生成
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Gacha Decoding（扭蛋解码），这是一种推理时方法，用于引出多样化的语言模型生成结果，且该方法能够随模型能力而扩展。在多个开放式领域（真实场景聊天、创意写作、图像生成规划以及蛋白质设计）中，Gacha Decoding在同等质量下显著优于现有的生成多样性方法（相比次优的先前方法，Vendi多样性指标最高提升2.4倍），以少一个数量级以上的样本（11.0倍）即可达到相同数量的高质量模式，并能发现其他任何方法都无法呈现的新颖模式。我们的核心洞察是将多样性视为一个指令遵循问题：不依赖于语言模型的token熵，而是将其指令遵循能力与外部随机数生成器（RNG）工具提供的随机性相结合，从而以可扩展的方式识别并实现响应空间中不同的模式。这种“掷骰子做规划”的方法使Gacha能够逆转长期观察到的多样性（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Gacha Decoding将多样性生成转化为指令遵循问题，通过结合语言模型的指令遵循能力与外部随机数生成器的随机性，在同等质量下将生成多样性最高提升2.4倍（Vendi指标），并以少11倍的样本发现高质量及新颖的生成模式。
en_tdlr: Gacha Decoding treats diversity as an instruction-following problem, combining the language model's instruction-following capability with randomness from an external RNG tool to achieve up to 2.4x higher generation diversity at equal quality (Vendi) while discovering high-quality and novel modes with 11x fewer samples.
